deadlines.notes: UWA lists 'Apply for Semester 1 by 11 January 2027' for most countries (Semester 2: 7 June 2027). Applicants from a listed group of countries (including Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Philippines, Sri Lanka, Vietnam) have earlier dates: 28 December 2026 and 24 May 2027. UWA adds that dates may change without notice and some courses have different dates.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Approved qualifications can show English competence: overseas secondary studies taught and examined in English (equivalent to Australian Year 12 with a pass in the final-year English paper, completed within two years); at least one successful year of full-time degree study in Canada (excluding Quebec), Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or the USA within the past two years; or specific English subjects/grades listed per qualification (for example IB English A SL grade 4 or HL grade 3). Test results are valid for two years.

english.notes: IELTS Academic (also IELTS for UKVI and One Skill Retake). Minimum standard: overall 6.5, no band below 6.0. Courses with a higher standard need 7.0 / 6.5 (not these three).
PTE Academic, minimum standard: overall 64, no band below 60.
Minimum standard: overall 125 with speaking 115, writing 125, reading 115, listening 110. Listed for the minimum standard only (no higher standard).
Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency, minimum standard: overall 170, speaking and writing 175, listening and reading 165.

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 77, 7th of the Australian universities in the table (A = ranks 6-15 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
